name: @mmo-engine/dungeon
description: Procedural dungeon layouts, baked offline: scatter, separate, Delaunay, MST + loops, room roles, carve, decorate. Deterministic per seed; a port of Dungeon Forge (MIT).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/wfc && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/placement && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/species && tsc -p tsconfig.json
